title: SVG tracer benchmarks
affiliation: Daniel Voshart develops Monotrace. The local comparisons were executed for this project; they are not independent evaluations.

dino.label: DINO ↑
dino.description: DINOv2 image-feature similarity. Higher is better; this is not a percentage accuracy or success rate.

median_boundary.label: Median boundary ↓
median_boundary.description: Median of per-image symmetric boundary errors in native input pixels.

mean_boundary.label: Mean boundary ↓
mean_boundary.description: Mean of per-image symmetric boundary errors. For font runs, an empty output against visible reference carries a 256 px penalty; blank against blank is zero.

iou.label: Ink IoU ↑
iou.description: Mean intersection-over-union of thresholded ink masks. Higher is better.

segments.label: Segments ↓
segments.description: Median line/curve segment count. Full-run counts use successful nonempty outputs. Fewer segments do not establish better reconstruction.

no_output.label: No output ↓
no_output.description: Visible reference images with no ink at scoring resolution, including explicit trace errors.

trace_errors.label: Trace errors ↓
trace_errors.description: Explicit unsuccessful conversion attempts; an empty SVG can still be a completed conversion.

topology.label: Topology flags ↓
topology.description: Images whose sampled component/hole counts differ. Resolution-dependent; not an exact vector topology or fabrication check.

dino_cosine.label: DINO ↑
dino_cosine.description: DINOv2 feature cosine similarity reported by the OmniSVG authors. Do not assume the local font scorer’s rescaling or preprocessing.

ssim.label: SSIM ↑
ssim.description: Published structural similarity of reconstructed and reference rasters; compare within the selected protocol.

lpips.label: LPIPS ↓
lpips.description: Published learned perceptual image patch distance; compare within the selected protocol.

mse.label: MSE ↓
mse.description: Published pixel mean squared error. Resolution, normalization and aggregation remain source-specific; not the local boundary error in pixels.

tokens_k.label: Tokens ↓
tokens_k.description: Reported average SVG token length in thousands, using the Qwen2.5-VL tokenizer. Rounded source values; not bytes, paths or curve segments.

paths.label: Paths ↓
paths.description: Reported average number of SVG paths, not the local median curve-segment count. Fewer paths do not by themselves prove better reconstruction.

reported_seconds.label: Reported time ↓
reported_seconds.description: Time cost reported in LayerTracer Table 2. Inference hardware and timing boundaries were not independently verified; not a cross-study speed comparison.

mean_dino.label: Mean ↑
mean_dino.description: Calculated equal mean of all five published SVG-Bench DINO scores. Requires every component; not published as an aggregate by StarVector and not a cross-paper rating.

stack.label: Stack ↑
stack.description: Published SVG-Stack DINO score from the pinned StarVector table.

fonts.label: Fonts ↑
fonts.description: Published SVG-Fonts DINO score from the pinned StarVector table.

icons.label: Icons ↑
icons.description: Published SVG-Icons DINO score from the pinned StarVector table.

emoji.label: Emoji ↑
emoji.description: Published SVG-Emoji DINO score from the pinned StarVector table.

runs.label: Fonts · our tests
runs.method: Original SVG framing, white background, no crop or automatic levels. Matched resvg 1024 px geometry renders, reported in native pixels. DINO uses resvg 256 px scoring images and the pinned DINOv2-base FP32 model.
runs.caveat: Monotrace has lower median error, while Potrace has a lower all-case mean after missing-output penalties. The published paper scores use a different or unverified pipeline. VTracer is a single untuned library configuration; published VTracer scores use a different or unverified pipeline. AutoTrace is a single untuned configuration; its DINO is below the other three tracers here.

rows.note: No explicit errors. One subpixel reference produces an empty SVG. Four completely white reference canvases are also retained.
Two explicit errors (unresolved span and contour budget), plus two completed empty SVGs against visible reference. Four visible references have no scoring ink in total.

VTracer 0.6.15 binary mode, library defaults, one untuned configuration, on the same 256 px input given to Monotrace. No explicit errors; three completed empty SVGs against visible references receive the 256 px penalty. All 4,821 source and input hashes were recreated and matched the frozen manifest; Potrace and Monotrace were not re-run. DINO features were recomputed with 8 threads and batch size 16 under the same formula and weights. Evidence: full-fonts-vtracer-summary.json, full-fonts-vtracer-provenance.json.

AutoTrace -color-count 2, otherwise defaults, one untuned configuration; input flattened onto white as RGB. Failures and empty outputs stay in every denominator; segment counts include its white background path. Potrace, Monotrace and VTracer were not re-run. Three completed outputs render with no ink against visible references and carry the 256 px penalty (the run script's own empty-output field misses them because AutoTrace always writes a background path). DINO features used 4 threads and batch size 8. Evidence: full-fonts-autotrace-summary.json, full-fonts-autotrace-provenance.json.

runs.label: PolyFit · our tests
runs.method: Matched resvg output renders at each original raster size. Geometry scores compare with the original raster pixels, not an original vector master.
runs.caveat: Measures raster reconstruction. It does not establish recovery of the artist’s intended curves, and the PolyFit algorithm itself was not run. The 116 files are 58 artworks at two size labels (not pixel sizes), so the effective sample is at most 58. Monotrace-minus-Potrace IoU is -0.0030 (paired bootstrap 95% interval [-0.0059, -0.0003] per case, [-0.0060, -0.0002] per artwork); the gap is at the -32 label (-0.0057) and not distinguishable from zero at -64 (-0.0004). There are no ground-truth vectors: IoU and boundary error measure fidelity to the thresholded raster only, so a lower score is not evidence of a worse contour. A three-row percentile index magnifies this small gap.

overview.sample_count_note: Each dataset gets equal weight, not each image. Original/simplified variants and exact evaluated case counts remain source-qualified. Methods can use dataset-specific configurations.
overview.summary: StarVector authors · mean DINO ↑ · calculated here
overview.method: Equal arithmetic mean of Stack, Fonts, Icons, Emoji and Diagrams from the same pinned StarVector publication. All five scores are required. This is a method-level summary of reported dataset-specific configurations, not one universal checkpoint. Rank is computed before search and sorting; exact ties share positions. Incomplete panels remain unranked.
overview.caveat: This fixed-panel summary does not combine papers or local scores. No missing dataset is filled, and dataset input token statistics are not output sizes.

matrix.note: One configuration per row. Relative index uses finite-cohort percentiles within exact protocols, averaged once per dataset family. Colour selection recalculates the index and ordinal position. A configuration measured only on monochrome tests can retain its index when the view changes. Released SVG-Icons is monochrome and now has a full local run; mixed-colour aggregates do not isolate gradient-only performance.
